description: List all workflow recordings stored in the database. Reports dbPath and dbFile (ok|missing|replaced|unknown), the file this server actually holds. A query on a deleted handle succeeds and returns nothing, so when dbFile is missing/replaced this THROWS rather than returning an empty list, and returns rows with a warning when it has some. Screen and video recordings are a separate table - see list_frame_sessions.
name: list_workflow_recordings
